title: apply --push names a delivery sent as a merge request as such, not as pushed to origin/main
goal: querylog.py apply --push prints that its commit went as the merge request of branch code/<sha> and origin/main did not move when kbgit.py sync sent it by the code lane, instead of 'pushed <sha> to origin/main' (run 20261012T134205Z-9997a0f4 in SP-kwi4ilty), so an orchestrator knows to wait for the merge before reading the store

run:
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_deliver
lines = []
p = ql_deliver.Pusher(Path(".").resolve(), Path("."), None, None, lines.append, cloud=False)
p.git = lambda *a, **k: (0, "deadbeefcafe0123\n", "")
p.tool = lambda name, *a: (0, "pushed: yes: branch code/ST-abcdefgh on origin (deadbeefc); main did not move\n", "")
assert p.deliver("run1") == 0
said = [ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith("apply --push:")]
assert said, lines
assert not any("origin/main" in ln for ln in said), said
assert any("merge request" in ln and "code/ST-abcdefgh" in ln for ln in said), said
